let block := fun x : ℕ => Finset.Ioc x (2*x); let window := fun x p : ℕ => (block x).filter (fun n => p^100000≤n^132301); let phase := fun p k (t : ℕ) => 2*Real.pi*(k : ℝ)*(t : ℝ)/(p : ℝ); let rootWave := fun q k t : ℕ => 2*Real.cos (phase q k t); let good := fun p a b r v : ℕ => p.Prime ∧ 2

(Finset.Ico 1 p).filter (fun k => min k (p-k)≤Nat.sqrt p); let amp := fun x p q t : ℕ => (∑ k ∈ low p, rootWave q (min k (p-k)) t * (∑ n ∈ window x p, Real.cos (phase p (min k (p-k)) n)) / (p : ℝ)) * Real.log p; let split := fun x : ℕ => (Finset.Ioc x ((2*x)^2+1)).filter (fun p => p.Prime ∧ p%4=1 ∧ p^100000≤(2*x)^132301); ∃ C : ℝ, 0

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然扩张 · QP-0091 · 给两个原中段素数带统一的次线性替换预算
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH and natural extensions · QP-0091 · Give a uniform sublinear replacement budget for either original middle prime band

brief.zh: 每个 p 将 k 和 p−k 配对，至多 2⌊√p⌋ 项。把 4π/√p·log p 累加至 (2x)^(132301/100000)。模型对 p−k 仍用模 p 配对后的 k；冻结式的 amp 以 min(k,p−k) 统一选择该代表。
brief.en: Pair k with p−k for each p, with at most 2⌊√p⌋ terms. Sum 4π log p/√p up to (2x)^(132301/100000). Both amplitudes use the paired representative min(k,p−k), including in the smaller modulus.
